runtimeLoading: SkillIcon.FindSkillIcon loads Sprite from Addressables by numeric skill ID. Every reference path resolves a registered MCombat SkillIcon group GUID.
referenceNote: MCombat has 97 SkillIcon entries for 96 IDs: ID 108 has both normal Skill/108.png and _Temp/SkillIconImports/tempskillicon/108.png. AddressablesImpl.LoadAssetAsync returns the first location with a provider (Addressables 2.9.1 AddressablesImpl.cs:598-602); the normal directory GUID is first in the source group. PocketStriker already matches the normal icon byte-for-byte, so 108 remains unchanged and no ambiguous temporary image is copied.
